{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state (e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).
- **Priority** – 1–5 scale (5 highest).
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry at the bottom of the file.
2. Update the status and priority as the idea progresses.
3. Keep the document updated so everyone has visibility.

---

### Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common queries.
Category: Feature
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state (e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).
- **Priority** – 1–5 scale (5 highest).
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

2. Update the status and priority as the idea progresses.
3. Keep the document updated so everyone has visibility.

Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common queries.
Category: Feature
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```

{"file_content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state(e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).
- **Priority** – 1–5 scale(5 highest).
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry at the bottom of the file.
2. Update the status and priority as the idea progresses.
3. Keep the document updated so everyone has visibility.

---

### Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common queries.
Category: Feature
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```

Fresh Ideas Tracker
===================

Purpose
-------
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

Structure
---------
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state (Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).

Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support

{"file_content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state(e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).
- **Priority** – 1–5 scale(5 highest).
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry at the bottom of the file.
2. Update the status and priority as the idea progresses.
3. Keep the document updated so everyone has visibility.

---

### Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common queries.
Category: Feature
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```
"}

{"file_content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state(e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).
- **Priority** – 1–5 scale(5 highest).
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry at the bottom of the file.
2. Update the status and priority as the idea progresses.
3. Keep the document updated so everyone has visibility.

---

### Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common queries.
Category: Feature
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```
"}

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state(e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).
- **Priority** – 1–5 scale(5 highest).
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry at the bottom of the file.
2. Update the status and priority as the idea progresses.
3. Keep the document updated so everyone has visibility.

---

```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common queries.
Category: Feature
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```

{"file_content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state(e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).
- **Priority** – 1–5 scale(5 highest).
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Use
1. Add a new entry at the bottom of the file.
2. Update the status and priority as the idea progresses.
3. Keep the document updated so everyone has visibility.

---

### Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support
Description: Implement a chatbot that handles common queries.
Category: Feature
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```
"}

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state(e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).
- **Priority** – 1–5 scale(5 highest).
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

1. Add a new entry at the bottom of the file.
2. Update the status and priority as the idea progresses.
3. Keep the document updated so everyone has visibility.

Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support

Category: Feature
Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Category** – e.g., Feature, Process Improvement, Marketing, etc.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Status** – Current state(e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected).

Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support

Owner: Jane Doe
Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.

Idea ID: 001

Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, brainstorming notes, and creative concepts that arise during our projects.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.

Idea ID: 001

Status: Draft
Priority: 4
Notes: Needs feasibility study.
```
